warnings: Every footing is printed 'F<n>, C2' — footing mark + the column stub C2 standing on it (C2 = 0.20x0.20, 6-DB12 on S-07). C2 is recorded once here (11 points); the floor-level columns are C1 on the S-01 structure view.

11 footings: F1 (single pile) at 9 points; F2 (two piles, 0.90 x 0.36 on S-06) only at A2 and B2, drawn with the 0.90 side along x. Row C has a footing only at C3; row E only at E2/E3 (carport columns).
